note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; each guide names the sources its facts come from. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap, PSNProfiles and Exophase trophy lists, GTA Zone trophy list, KeenGamer trophy guide, Output Lag trophy list.

roadmap.detail: Finish all five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go. Do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation the morning after 'Down to Earth' - it is the only trophy PowerPyx flags as potentially missable.
roadmap.title: Play the story, Chapters 1-5

roadmap.detail: Finish the final mission for each side character (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. These unlock as you meet people across Leonida.
roadmap.title: Side characters & strangers

roadmap.detail: Collectible card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas of Leonida, 8 garage properties, 10 vehicles registered to Scooter Bros.
roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration

roadmap.detail: 250 stunts, 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 20 race wins, Top Fun drone races at all 14 locations, fishing, arcade, bowling, meditation at all 18 spots, 50 challenges.
roadmap.title: Activities & grind

roadmap.detail: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. The checklist is roughly 60% of true completion - most of it is already done by following this roadmap. Finish the last one-off trophies, then the platinum pops.
roadmap.title: 100% completion & cleanup

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned - there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, so treat this as the finish line of the roadmap, not a task of its own. Work the stages in order: story first, then side characters, collectibles, activities, and finally the 100% checklist. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; PSNProfiles trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it unlocks at the mission's end. No special conditions - just play the mission through. It is the first story trophy, so it also confirms your save and progress tracking are working. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every main mission of Chapter 1. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see Positive Mental Attitude) - PowerPyx flags that one moment as the set's only potentially missable trophy, and there is no mission replay. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every main mission of Chapter 2. This is the chapter where both Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up most of the side content - activities, strangers and collectibles that need both characters. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every main mission of Chapter 3. Robbery trophies start to open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so from here on, try the robbery side content (armored trucks, bank vaults, illegal operations) as it appears instead of leaving it all for after the story. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every main mission of Chapter 4. By now the map is fully open and most activities are available; use the gaps between missions to chip away at stunts, vehicle scanning and animal study, which all count toward later trophies. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the final mission and the credits roll. It is the only hidden gold trophy. Before starting it, make a manual save - PowerPyx notes there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a separate save before the finale is cheap insurance for any last optional content. After the story, free-roam continues and the 100% checklist opens. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one unlock by playing the main path - no side requirement, no choice to get wrong. If a mission feels hard, it is still the same difficulty for everyone: PowerPyx notes there are no difficulty settings. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this pops at the mission's end with no extra objective. Use heist practice for the separate robbery trophies later - vaults and armored trucks use similar escape driving. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Child's Play. Like every named story mission trophy, it unlocks by completing that mission once - there is no gold-medal or time requirement, since PowerPyx confirms there are no mission medals at all. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Headliners. Play the main path and it pops at the end of the mission. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway - with no mission replay, a chapter-start save is the only way back if you later want to redo a story moment. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also the setting of the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, so learn the airport layout here - runways, exits and where aircraft sit - for that later trophy. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies; after it, only the chapter finales and the final mission remain on the story path. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the last one most players earn. Open the checklist after the story at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion - progress made during the story already counts, and PowerPyx stresses nothing toward 100% is missable. The checklist is lenient: PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, needing 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied. Follow this guide's roadmap stages 1-4 and most of the checklist fills itself; then mop up whatever rows are left. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: A pure grind: pull off 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida - jumps, near-misses, drifts and air time all count toward the running total, which you can watch in Stats. Start early and stunt whenever you travel instead of driving carefully; by the end of the story a big chunk is already done. Unique stunt jumps are the most reliable source: find a jump, land it clean, move on. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all 9 activity types once each - PowerPyx's list of types includes the side activities of the game (races, fishing, arcade, bowling, shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and similar). This is a sampler, not a grind: open the activities menu or the map icons, try one of each, and tick them off in this tracker as you go so you can see which type is still missing. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range challenge has a score threshold for gold; PowerPyx lists 42 challenges across the range's weapon courses. Work through them weapon by weapon, learn each course's target layout on a first run, then go for the gold score - accuracy beats speed on most courses, so take the aimed shots and skip the spray. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race course; you only need one win per location, not every race at each spot. Fly the course once slowly to learn the gates, then race it for real - cutting a gate costs more time than the shortcut saves. Tick locations off in this tracker as you win them. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races - different events, not the same race 20 times. Races are spread across Leonida (street, off-road, water and air events all count as race types where offered). Pick the fastest vehicle you own for each event's class, learn the first lap, and use the later laps to overtake cleanly. Track which events you have won so you do not repeat one by mistake. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Fishing challenges are scored on catch weight or count, so use the best rod and bait you have and fish where the challenge marker points - bigger fish live in deeper water. If you lose, you can challenge him again; there is no penalty for a retry. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full game at an arcade - any machine, any game. Arcades are found in entertainment venues around Vice City; walk up to a cabinet, start a game and play it to its end (or its game-over screen after completing it, depending on the machine). One completion is all this trophy asks. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy, unmissable in the sense that Andy's mission strand stays available: play Andy's missions to their end and the trophy pops at the final one. Side-character missions appear as icons on the map after the story introduces them - do them when they appear rather than hoarding them, because later story progress can move characters around. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: play Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Kenton's missions unlock as the story introduces him; each one appears on the map, so clear them in order and the finale - and this trophy - follow naturally. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: play Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Billy's strand is one of five side-character arcs; none of them is timed, but doing each strand soon after it opens keeps the map readable and the characters where you expect them. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Strangers appear as question-mark icons across Leonida; each strand is several missions long. You need 8 complete strands, so start every stranger you meet and finish strands one at a time - PowerPyx puts this in its final cleanup stage, about 10 hours alongside the side-character finales. Note that optional stranger missions can disappear from the map after a while, but PowerPyx notes that does not block any trophy. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: play Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy's arc is one of the five side-character finales in roadmap stage 2; finish each character's strand when it opens and this trophy follows. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: play Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. With Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone all finished, stage 2 of the roadmap is done and only collectibles, activities and the 100% checklist remain. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. PowerPyx is explicit: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 - after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That spot is gone after Chapter 1, and there is no mission replay. Do it the moment it is offered, then meditate at every other spot whenever the prompt appears. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 spots, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he names. Study animals through binoculars first - PowerPyx notes 100 of 255 animals studied counts toward 100%, and studying the target before the hunt helps you find it. Track the animal, take a clean shot, and return to Bret. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida - in shops, interiors and out in the world. A set is complete only when every card in it is found, so work set by set and tick cards off in this tracker (or a map checklist) rather than grabbing at random. Three sets is the trophy; more sets may count toward 100%. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are scattered through the whole map, so this is a long exploration grind - combine it with the Goodtime State exploration trophy and the vehicle-scanning grind, sweeping region by region so no area is left half-done. The counter in Stats shows your progress. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges from the game's challenge list (80 in total). Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and activities, so most complete themselves while you chase other trophies - check the challenge list regularly and pick off the easy ones (short, repeatable challenges first). The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to A Long Road. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in open country where you can break line of sight - drive fast, go off-road, then hide until the stars blink out. Keep your partner with you the whole time; if they are left behind or busted, the attempt does not count. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them - the chain breaks if the heat drops to zero, so plan a tight route of three nearby shops and drive straight from one to the next. Keep the wanted level low (one or two stars) by robbing quickly and moving on; a slow getaway with a big wanted level makes the chain much harder. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles - get close enough for the game to register each new model. Drive everywhere and scan what you pass; PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so 100 discovered is a milestone on that longer road. Rare models hide in specific districts and at specific times, so sweep region by region rather than circling one area. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up where enemies cluster - a gang hideout or a mission firefight with plenty of cover - and trigger Combat Focus only when five targets are in view. Aim for headshots and keep moving between targets; wasting the focus on one or two enemies means starting over. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an aircraft without a scheduled flight - steal a plane or helicopter on the tarmac and take off. Expect an immediate wanted level and airport security, so pick a fast aircraft, get airborne quickly and fly low out over the water. You learned the airport's layout in the story mission VCIA Takedown; use that knowledge here. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into the action with Rhino tanks - the description's joke is the clue. Find a Rhino (military areas and high wanted-level responses are where tanks show up), get inside or take one on, and survive the encounter. Bring heavy weapons and a fast escape vehicle, because a tank's cannon ends a fight quickly if you stand in the open. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and stay undetected from entry to exit - no alarms, no witnesses calling the police, no cameras spotting you. Scout the store first, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone reacts. If you are spotted, leave and try again later; a detected attempt does not count. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the bigger robbery targets: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and lose the wanted level before the next. Do them one at a time with a getaway vehicle parked close, and keep your wanted level manageable - a clean escape after each vault is what the trophy counts. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida - find one on the road, stop it (ram it, block it or force the driver out), crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level that follows. A quiet road away from police patrols makes the escape far easier than a downtown robbery. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have set foot in, so sweep the state region by region - coast, swamps, suburbs and Vice City itself - and check the map for areas still unvisited. Combine this with the WAiNK sweep and vehicle scanning so one trip covers three trophies at once. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs operations in its own territory, so you will travel the whole map for this one - learn which gang holds which area, hit one operation per gang, and tick gangs off in this tracker as you go. A stolen operation usually brings heat, so plan the escape before you go in. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and enjoy it. This is a hidden one-off: the trigger is the location plus the drink, so sit at a beachfront bar, order the cocktail and let the scene play. No fighting, no timer - just the view. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list. Note: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact trigger as not yet pinned down - treat the beachfront-bar cocktail as the best-supported reading of the official description.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight through a showroom's glass front and out the other side, in the classic style the description hints at. Pick a showroom with a big glass frontage, build speed on the approach and smash through - the trophy is about the exit, so keep driving until you are clear of the building. Expect a wanted level and some repair bills. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list. Note: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact trigger as not yet pinned down - the showroom smash is the best-supported reading of the official description.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through - play a full game there. The alley is a named location, so the trophy is tied to that specific venue rather than any bowling lane. Play the game to its end; a full game is what counts. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Do something with your partner that the whole state notices - the description points to a partner moment with a big audience. The likeliest reading is a public partner activity that draws a crowd or media attention; try partner activities in busy Vice City spots and watch for the pop. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide. Note: the exact trigger is not yet pinned down by PowerPyx - this guide says so rather than inventing a step.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Make choices that shape your Criminal Profile - the trophy tracks a count toward 500, per the trophy databases. Choices appear all through the game: dialogue options, how you handle strangers, whether you go loud or quiet. Just keep playing and choosing; the count climbs in the background. One caution from GTA Zone's reading: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile on purpose, since that profile is permanent. Sources: GTA Zone trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second try - the description is the clue. Fail an activity once (a race, a challenge, a minigame), then win it on the immediate retry. If it does not pop, try a different activity: the trigger is the second-attempt success, not any one event. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list. Note: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact trigger as not yet pinned down - the second-try reading follows the official description.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange - a hidden encounter or easter egg somewhere in Leonida. These moments are unmarked by design: explore odd locations (remote spots, late at night, unusual landmarks) and the encounter finds you. PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet pinned down, so this guide does not invent a location - explore widely, especially after the story, and it should surface. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle - a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun. Get a passenger or partner to swing, or drive slowly past a target and strike as you pass. It takes timing more than speed: line the vehicle up, strike at the last moment, and keep moving. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide. Note: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact trigger as not yet pinned down - the melee drive-by reading follows the official description.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep robbing (vaults, armored trucks, illegal operations) and launder every batch - the total accumulates across the whole game, so this trophy finishes itself if you keep the money moving instead of sitting on dirty cash. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops - weapons, clothes, vehicles, food, anything sold in a shop counts toward the running total. Buy what you need for other trophies (weapons for the range, vehicles for races) and the total climbs on its own; if it is still short near the end, buy and sell high-value items to close the gap. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; Output Lag trophy list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the property market - each one gives you storage and a fast-travel point, so buy them as you can afford them rather than all at once. The trophy pops when the eighth deed is yours. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; KeenGamer trophy guide.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are registered. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover is a candidate for registration. Sources: PowerPyx trophy guide & roadmap; GTA Zone trophy list.
trophies.name: On the Spot
